questions.question: Evaluate the claim that selective breeding always improves a species.
questions.modelAnswer:
It can increase desired characteristics, but repeated breeding from a small gene pool reduces genetic variation and increases inbreeding and inherited defects.
Reduced variation may lower ability to adapt to disease or environmental change, so “always improves” is not justified.
